name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Measures ability to make correct decisions or inferences from numerical/statistical data. Suitable for managerial, graduate, and professional roles requiring data interpretation.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Measures ability to understand and evaluate verbal information. Suitable for roles that require strong communication, comprehension, and analytical writing skills.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures ability to identify patterns and relationships among abstract figures. Key predictor of complex problem-solving and innovation.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning
description: Measures ability to draw logical conclusions from given statements. Particularly relevant for legal, analytical, and technical roles.

name: Verify Mechanical Comprehension
description: Measures understanding of mechanical principles and physical concepts. Ideal for engineering, manufacturing, and technical trade roles.

name: Verify G+ Ability
description: Adaptive general cognitive ability test measuring numerical, verbal, and deductive reasoning together. Fast, highly accurate measure of overall learning potential.

name: Verify Numerical Ability
description: Basic numerical ability test covering arithmetic, percentages, and simple data. Suitable for clerical, frontline, and entry-level roles.

name: Verify Verbal Ability
description: Basic verbal ability test covering grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension. Suitable for customer service, clerical, and frontline roles.

name: Verify Checking
description: Measures attention to detail and accuracy when checking information. Key for data entry, administrative, financial, and compliance roles.

name: Numerical Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive numerical reasoning using tables and charts. Mirrors real-world business data analysis tasks for managerial and professional roles.

name: Verbal Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive verbal reasoning with complex passages and multi-part questions. Designed for senior management and professional assessment.

name: OPQ32r
description: The OPQ32r is SHL's flagship occupational personality questionnaire measuring 32 personality characteristics relevant to work. Predicts performance across all job types and levels.

name: OPQ32n
description: Normative version of the OPQ32 personality questionnaire. Provides richer profile information for development and senior-level selection contexts.

name: Motivation Questionnaire (MQ)
description: Measures 18 dimensions of workplace motivation. Helps understand what energizes and de-motivates an individual, used for selection, development, and engagement.

name: Universal Competency Framework (UCF) 360
description: 360-degree feedback tool mapping to SHL's Universal Competency Framework. Measures 8 competency factors for leadership and professional development.

name: Graduate and Managerial Assessment (GMA)
description: Comprehensive cognitive battery covering abstract, verbal, and numerical reasoning for graduate and early-career professional selection.

name: Java 8 (New)
description: Tests knowledge of Java 8 features including streams, lambdas, functional interfaces, Optional, and Date/Time API. Suitable for mid to senior Java developers.

name: Core Java
description: Assesses foundational Java programming: OOP principles, exception handling, collections, multithreading, and basic I/O. For junior to mid-level Java roles.

name: Advanced Java
description: Deep Java assessment covering JVM internals, concurrency, design patterns, Spring, Hibernate, and microservices. For senior Java engineers and architects.

name: Python (New)
description: Assesses Python programming: syntax, data structures, OOP, standard library, decorators, generators, and error handling.

name: SQL (New)
description: Tests SQL skills: SELECT queries, JOINs, aggregations, subqueries, window functions, indexes, and transactions. For data and backend developer roles.

name: JavaScript (New)
description: Assesses JavaScript: ES6+, closures, prototypes, async/await, DOM manipulation, and event handling. Suitable for frontend and full-stack developers.

name: C# (New)
description: Tests C# and .NET knowledge: LINQ, generics, async programming, delegates/events, and ASP.NET fundamentals.

name: C++ (New)
description: Assesses C++ skills: memory management, pointers, STL, templates, OOP, and concurrency. For systems and embedded software roles.

name: HTML/CSS
description: Measures knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, flexbox, and accessibility. For frontend developer and web designer roles.

name: ReactJS
description: Tests React.js knowledge: components, hooks, state management, lifecycle, and integration with REST APIs.

name: .NET Framework (New)
description: Evaluates .NET framework knowledge: CLR, WCF, Entity Framework, MVC, and dependency injection patterns.

name: Data Science
description: Covers statistical concepts, machine learning fundamentals, Python data libraries (pandas, scikit-learn), and data visualization for data science roles.

name: Machine Learning
description: Tests knowledge of ML algorithms, model evaluation, feature engineering, neural networks, and deployment for ML engineer and data scientist roles.

name: Microsoft Excel (New)
description: Assesses Excel proficiency: formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts, and data analysis. Relevant across finance, admin, and analyst roles.

name: Financial Accounting
description: Tests knowledge of accounting principles: P&L, balance sheets, cash flow, debits/credits, and financial reporting for finance roles.

name: Business Etiquette
description: Evaluates professional communication, email etiquette, meeting behavior, and workplace conduct for customer-facing and corporate roles.

name: Customer Service Skills
description: Measures customer service knowledge: complaint handling, empathy, de-escalation, and service standards. For contact centre and retail roles.

name: Project Management
description: Tests PM knowledge: scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder management, and PM methodologies (Agile, PMP concepts). For PM and delivery roles.

name: Agile Software Development
description: Evaluates understanding of Agile principles, Scrum, Kanban, sprints, and team ceremonies for software engineering and product roles.

name: UNIX/Linux
description: Assesses Linux command-line skills, shell scripting, file systems, permissions, and process management. For DevOps, sysadmin, and backend roles.

name: AWS Cloud Practitioner
description: Tests foundational AWS knowledge: core services (EC2, S3, RDS), security, pricing, and cloud architecture principles.

name: DevOps
description: Covers CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and monitoring tools for DevOps engineer roles.

name: Automata - Pro (Coding Simulation)
description: Real-world coding simulation where candidates write working code in an IDE-like environment. Tests problem-solving, code quality, and language proficiency for software engineers.

name: Automata Selenium
description: Coding simulation focused on Selenium WebDriver test automation. Candidates write real automation scripts evaluated for correctness and quality.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Technology
description: SJT presenting realistic technology workplace scenarios assessing collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making competencies for tech roles.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Customer Service
description: SJT with realistic customer-facing scenarios measuring service orientation, empathy, and conflict resolution for frontline and contact centre roles.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Management
description: SJT scenarios covering team leadership, performance management, delegation, and stakeholder management for managerial candidates.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Graduate
description: Entry-level SJT assessing work ethic, teamwork, and professional judgment for graduate and early-career selection.

name: Workplace English Assessment
description: Assesses English language proficiency in professional contexts: reading comprehension, business writing, grammar, and vocabulary for global workforce screening.

name: Entry Level Sales Aptitude
description: Measures sales aptitude, persuasion style, and commercial awareness for entry-level sales representative roles.

name: General Ability (Short)
description: Quick screener measuring overall cognitive ability through numerical, verbal, and abstract reasoning. Suitable for high-volume frontline and clerical selection.

name: Operational Safety Assessment
description: SJT assessing safety awareness, risk judgment, and procedural compliance for manufacturing, logistics, and industrial roles.

name: Dependability & Safety Instrument (DSI)
description: Personality-based instrument measuring conscientiousness, rule-following, and safety mindedness. Predicts counterproductive work behaviours and absenteeism.

name: Retail Solution (Cashier)
description: Work simulation for retail cashier roles covering transaction accuracy, customer service, and following procedures under time pressure.

name: Call Centre Simulation
description: Simulates a customer service call environment. Tests multitasking, typing accuracy, empathy, and problem resolution for contact centre roles.

name: Angular
description: Tests Angular framework knowledge: components, modules, services, RxJS, routing, and TypeScript integration for frontend developer roles.

name: Node.js
description: Assesses Node.js: event loop, Express, middleware, REST APIs, async patterns, and npm ecosystem for backend and full-stack developers.

name: Salesforce Administrator
description: Tests Salesforce platform knowledge: objects, workflows, reports, security model, and CRM administration for Salesforce admin and ops roles.

name: Cyber Security Fundamentals
description: Covers network security, threat vectors, encryption, access control, and incident response fundamentals for security analyst and IT roles.

name: Supply Chain Management
description: Tests knowledge of procurement, logistics, inventory management, demand planning, and supplier relationships for operations and supply chain roles.

name: Entry Level Data Entry
description: Simulates real data entry tasks measuring accuracy, speed, and attention to detail. For administrative, clerical, and back-office roles.

name: R Programming
description: Assesses R language skills: data manipulation (dplyr, tidyr), visualization (ggplot2), statistical analysis, and scripting for data analyst and data scientist roles.

name: Scala
description: Tests Scala language skills including functional programming, collections, pattern matching, concurrency (Akka), and big data applications.

name: TypeScript
description: Assesses TypeScript: type system, interfaces, generics, decorators, and integration with modern frameworks for frontend and full-stack roles.

name: Entry Level Cognitive Assessment (ELCA)
description: Short cognitive screener designed for high-volume, entry-level and frontline hiring. Covers basic numerical, verbal, and problem-solving skills efficiently.
